headline: Report says AI financial payoff is concentrated in the Magnificent Seven
summary: A new comparison finds that revenue-per-employee gains from AI have gone almost entirely to the Magnificent Seven technology companies, while the rest of the S&P 500 sees little to no financial benefit, according to analysis attributed to private-equity firm Apollo.

claims.statement: Revenue per employee at the Magnificent Seven has outpaced the rest of the S&P 500.

sources.quote: Revenue per employee at the Magnificent Seven has outpaced the S&P 493

claims.statement: The comparison highlights a growing divide between Big Tech and the rest of corporate America.

sources.quote: growing divide in fortunes between America

claims.statement: Apollo's analysis says the AI payoff is strictly limited to Big Tech.

sources.quote: AI payoff strictly limited to Big Tech

claims.statement: The rest of the S&P 500 sees no benefit from the AI boom, per the analysis.

sources.quote: the rest of the S&P 500 see no benefit, claims Apollo
